faq_heading: Homes near Senator Reid Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Senator Reid Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Senator Reid Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Senator Reid Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Senator Reid Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are David Brankin Elementary (0.6 km south-east), L.A. Matheson Secondary (0.8 km west) and Kirkbride Elementary (0.9 km west).

Senator Reid Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 9341 126 St. It teaches grades K to 7.
Use the search below to see homes for sale that name Senator Reid Elementary in the listing.
How the Senator Reid Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Senator Reid Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit some distance away. Ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Senator Reid Elementary

30 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Senator Reid Elementary in a straight line (19 elementary, 9 secondary, 2 other; 4 independent). The closest is David Brankin Elementary, 0.6 km away, and the farthest on this list is K B Woodward Elementary, 2.7 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is L.A. Matheson Secondary (0.8 km); the nearest independent school is Immaculate Conception School (1.6 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Kwantlen Park Secondary (2.5 km). Other elementary schools close by: David Brankin Elementary (0.6 km south-east), Kirkbride Elementary (0.9 km west), Cedar Hills Elementary (1.0 km north-west), Betty Huff Elementary (1.0 km east), Prince Charles Elementary (1.4 km north). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is David Brankin Elementary, 0.6 km south-east of Senator Reid Elementary.
